data.body:
[P2] Reconcile retirement with an already terminal execution history

A collected history with status `FAILED` can have retirement outcome `SUCCEEDED` and still pass final validation: this check only requires membership in the terminal-status set. The consistency check in `validate_retirement_evidence` does not protect the offline CLI, which never calls it. Require retirement to match any already terminal collected history, while allowing an earlier `RUNNING` or `PENDING` snapshot to become terminal. Add a contradictory-terminal-outcome regression test.
